steps.title: Create a New Workbook
steps.instruction: Open Excel online and create a new blank workbook.
steps.explanation: Starting a new workbook provides a clean grid environment to build the data table.
steps.expectedResult: A new, blank Excel sheet titled 'Book 3' opens on the screen.
steps.caption: Initiate creation of a new Excel workbook.

steps.title: Enter Table Header Row
steps.instruction: In row 1, enter column headers across columns A to E: 'Order ID', 'Customer', 'Product', 'Quantity', and 'Total Price'.
steps.explanation: Defining clear headers establishes the structure and content type for each column in the table.
steps.expectedResult: Cells A1 through E1 display the specified header labels.
steps.caption: Populate the column headers across row 1.

steps.title: Enter First Data Row
steps.instruction: In row 2, enter the order details: Order ID 'ORD-1001', Customer 'Acme Corp', Product 'Widget A', Quantity '50', and Total Price '$250.00'.
steps.explanation: Populating row 2 enters the initial data record into the spreadsheet.
steps.expectedResult: Row 2 displays all values for the first order entry.
steps.caption: Fill in data for the first order in row 2.

steps.title: Enter Second Data Row
steps.instruction: In row 3, enter the order details: Order ID 'ORD-2002', Customer 'ABC', Product 'Widget B', Quantity '100', and Total Price '$500.00'.
steps.explanation: Adding row 3 appends the second order record to the dataset.
steps.expectedResult: Row 3 displays all values for the second order entry.
steps.caption: Fill in data for the second order in row 3.

steps.title: Enter Third Data Row
steps.instruction: In row 4, enter the order details: Order ID 'ORD-2003', Customer 'DEF', Product 'Widget C', Quantity '200', and Total Price '$1,000.00'.
steps.explanation: Adding row 4 appends the third order record to complete the data table.
steps.expectedResult: Row 4 displays all values for the third order entry.
steps.caption: Fill in data for the third order in row 4.
